cohort: The study included 345 pregnant women referred to a maternity hospital in Rasht, Iran, followed from gestational age >37 weeks until delivery.
finding: The highest prevalence of maternal diabetes mellitus and cesarean section was found in women >35 years, while maternal age <19 years was a predictor of adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The highest prevalence of cesarean section (72.46%) was reported in the age group >35 years, and delivery by cesarean section significantly differed between the maternal age groups.
